question: As per statistics published by National Crime Records Bureau for 2020, which state tops in total number of crime incidences against senior citizens (60 years and above)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Crime Records Bureau**

 
 
• The Indian government's **National Crime Records Bureau, also known as NCRB**, is in charge of gathering and examining **information on crimes as they are described in the Indian Penal Code (IPC) and other Special and Local Laws (SLL)**.
 
• The** Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)**, which is a part of the Indian government, **houses NCRB's headquarters in New Delhi**.
 
• **Ramphal Pawar (IPS) **is the National Crime Record Bureau's **current director**.
 
• In order to help investigators to make link between crimes and their perpetrators, **NCRB was established in 1986**.
 
• As per statistics published by **National Crime Records Bureau for 2020**, **Maharashtra tops in total number of crime incidences against senior citizens (60 years and above)**.
 
• Maharashtra accounts for** 4909 number of crime against the senior citizens**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A total of **24,794 cases of crimes against senior citizens (those over 60) were reported in 2020**, a decrease of **10.8% from 2019 (27,804 cases)**.
